start_cutoff_speed.phase: explicit ordered settings; applies to subsequent plunger moves until changed
start_cutoff_speed.controller_conversion: configured maximum volume; increments/s rounded to nearest integer
start_cutoff_speed.controller_interaction: actual start/cutoff temporarily limited by top speed; readback reports programmed value
start_cutoff_speed.persistence: working memory only; no NVRAM save emitted
start_cutoff_speed.advisory: 30053815-C p36 discourages cutoff >100 uL/s (lost steps/overload), especially adjacent moves without >10 ms delay; 399156 p9 uses 200 uL/s. No cap or delay is inserted.
